clients.merge_strategy: TOML managed block upsert；保留其他 providers、models、services 与 thinking。
JSON 增量 upsert 协议独立 Provider；保留其他 Provider 与配置。
App 与 CLI 配置分别增量合并；保留 MCP、Skill、Hook、权限和其他 Provider。
只 upsert Antigravity owned settings；保留其他 Gemini 配置。
增量 upsert 独立 laoshirenai Provider 与 model；保留其他 Provider、Skills、MCP、Hooks 和 Gateway 配置。

Strictly deep-merge only documented non-secret Qoder fields. BYOK provider, Base URL, Key, and credential-store writes are blocked until Qoder documents a safe arbitrary-provider API; preserve all Skills, Plugins, MCP, Hooks, permissions, and unowned settings.

Strictly parse YAML and upsert only one dedicated custom_provider entry plus explicitly selected defaultModel/defaultModelVariant. Never touch runtime SQLite/auth files or managed provider.minimax; preserve Agents, memory, Skills, MCP, Plugins, TUI, permissions, and unowned fields. Automatic Key write is disabled while 0.2.7 persists raw credentials outside Agent Switch.

Strictly parse YAML, back up the managed documents, upsert protocol-specific laoshirenai Provider rows and credential references only, preserve other providers/profiles/plugins, and atomically replace.

decision: No automatic write command is published until safe write, backup, and idempotency are verified. Manual documentation remains available.
